heading: What you can expect over time.
lede: What people tell us they notice, and roughly when. Everyone’s different, so score yourself on day 1 and compare.
foot: Based on what customers tell us, not a clinical study. Everyone’s different.

milestones.title: Your baseline
milestones.text: Score your afternoons, sleep and recovery out of 10, or note your wearable’s numbers. Then two capsules with breakfast.

milestones.title: Afternoons that hold
milestones.text: Usually the first thing people notice. B vitamins help reduce tiredness and fatigue, and NR tops up the NAD+ your cells use to make energy. Less of a 3pm slump, and energy left for the evening.

milestones.title: Bouncing back sooner
milestones.text: Vitamin D supports normal muscle function, and CoQ10 and PQQ support your mitochondria. A walk, a round of golf or a gym session stops hanging around for days.

milestones.title: Feeling like yourself
milestones.text: Compare your scores with day 1. Many people say they hadn’t realised how flat they’d been feeling. Not for you? Get every subscription payment back.
